item.title: Freemius Button
item.dc:creator: xaver
item.content:encoded:
Hello! I'm working on a plugin to quickly turn any (block based) button into a Freemius Checkout button. Here's a test to purchase my plugin (Mailster):

Buy Now
Free
Starter
Professional

The button provides basically (almost) all options from the offical docs. Just click on the button and enable the "Freemius Checkout " checkbox.

My goal is to make it easy to create checkout button if you sell on Freemius.

You need at least one properties

  • product_id

All other options are optional but please check the offical docs.

Scopes

Freemius Button can work with three scopes: Global, Page and Button. This way you can define settings for your whole site/page which can get overwritten specifically.

The "Button" scope overwrites settings from "Page" which overwrites settings from "Global"

Global

The global scope stores the value in the wp_options table. Data can be used across your whole site.

Page

This scope is for the current page. It is stored in the post_meta table and is valid for the current page only. It inherits the Global settings.

Button

These is for individual buttons. The data is stored in the block attributes. It inherits data from the Page settings as well the Global settings.

Filters

I've added a filter you can use to change the arguments on-the file which works something like that:

add_filter('freemius_button_data', function($data) {
	$data['plan_id'] = 456;
	return $data;
});

Frequently Asked

Learn about our product

Got a question? We've got you covered! Check out the resources below and be sure to let us know if we can answer anything else.

What exactly is Ollie?

Ollie is a WordPress block theme that is designed to work with the new WordPress Site Editor. That means your site can be built with blocks, patterns, and other design elements that can be easily edited without any coding skills.

Do I need any other plugins?

Nope! Ollie is designed to work with the native WordPress editor, meaning you don't need a page builder plugin to build a beautiful website on WordPress anymore. Of course, you can continue using your favorite plugins alongside Ollie!

What if I've never used the Site Editor?

Don't worry, we'll show you around! The Site Editor is fairly new, and lots of folks are still trying it out for the first time. There's a lot to learn, but the site building power you'll unlock with all of the new design tools will be well worth it!

What are patterns?

Patterns are pre-designed page elements that you can drag and drop to create unique designs. Ollie comes with an extensive collection of expertly-designed patterns, but you can also design your own patterns.
